title: Formal-fibre system compatibility for the fixed degree-zero augmentation
statement: Let f:X→Y be a scheme morphism and y∈Y. Let α be the O_(Y,y)-linear stalk map of the canonical augmentation f_*O_X → R^0f_*O_X [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. Let C and S be the formal-fibre zeroth cohomology and section inverse systems [def-weil-pbc-formal-fibre-cohomology]. There exists an isomorphism b:C≅S over the completed local ring such that for every n, every canonical theta with IsFormalFunctionsTheta, every V containing y whose inverse image in X_n is the whole fibre, and every t∈Γ(f^(-1)V,O_X), b_n(theta(α(germ_V(t))))=i_n^*(t). The augmentation α is fixed; no stalk equivalence is chosen or asserted. Pullback of the unit module is tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], and the cohomology transitions and canonical theta use the cohomology h-maps [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap].

proof.text: Import all FormalFunctionsDegreeZeroSystemIso and use its existing private zeroIso, levelIso and levelIso_naturality without redeclaring them. NatTrans.ofOpSequence assembles the canonical component homomorphisms using that transition theorem; componentwise IsIso gives asIso b. These components are actual constructions, not arbitrary witnesses selected from the existential systemIso theorem.

Apply formalFunctions_degreeZero_augmented_sections with F the unit module. This identifies theta of the fixed augmented germ with the global-sections augmentation of the restricted tensor-unit image of t.

The explicit b_n is global sections of tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit after zeroIso, with restriction of scalars. Its zeroIso cancels the canonical augmentation by the inverse-hom identity. Naturality of tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit moves it through the section restriction along hV. Evaluate its adjunction-unit characterization on t to obtain the structure-sheaf section map. By the definition of appLE, the remaining restriction is exactly i_n.appLE(f inverse V,top,hV)(t).

theorem formalFunctions_degreeZero_augmentation_compatibility {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (y : Y) :
    ∃ b : formalFibreCohomologySystem f y (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 0 ≅
          formalFibreSectionsSystem f y,
        ∀ (n : ℕ)
          (θ : formalFunctionsStalk f y (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 0 →ₗ[
            Y.presheaf.stalk y]
            formalFibreCohomologyLocal f y (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 0 n),
          IsFormalFunctionsTheta f y (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) 0 n θ →
          ∀ (V : Y.Opens) (hy : y ∈ V)
            (hV : (⊤ : (formalFibre f y n).Opens) ≤
              (formalFibreι f y n) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) (t : Γ(X, f ⁻¹ᵁ V)),
            (b.hom.app (op n)) (θ (((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace y).map
              ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).toRightDerivedZero.app
                (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))).hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ
              ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj
                (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).val.presheaf V y hy t))) =
              (formalFibreι f y n).appLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) ⊤ hV t
